summary: Wise Group plc, the UK-listed cross-border payments group, filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Barak Eilam as Non-Executive Director and Chair Designate, succeeding David Wells, who has chaired since 2021 and will step down as Chair and Director in April 2027. Eilam, former CEO of NICE from 2014 to 2024, will chair the Nominating and Corporate Governance committee. No terms, stake, price, premium, advisors or regulatory clocks are stated. This is a planned board leadership transition rather than a forced or abrupt departure, so no special-situation angle; watch for strategic continuity under CEO Kristo Käärmann.
